login.title: Sign in
login.expired_subtitle: Sign-in links only work for a short while.

register.head: Create an account
register.title: Create your account
register.start_subtitle: Accounts are created while signing in to an application.
register.closed_body: {app} does not allow creating accounts here. Ask whoever runs it for access.
forgot.head: Reset your password
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent_body: If an account exists for {email}, we’ve sent a link to reset its password. It works for one hour.
forgot.sent_hint: Didn’t get it? Check your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.
reset.head: Choose a new password
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.temporary: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own to continue.
reset.done_body: Your password has been changed, and you’ve been signed out everywhere else.
reset.expired_body: Reset links work once, for one hour. Ask for a new one and use the latest email.
logged_out.head: Signed out
logged_out.title: You’re signed out
logged_out.body: You have been signed out on this device.
error.head: Sign-in error
error.title: We couldn’t sign you in
error.body: Go back to the application and try again. If it keeps happening, contact its support.
error.body_support: Go back to the application and try again. If it keeps happening, contact its support, or ours below.
profile.head: Profile
profile.personal_description: Your name, as applications you sign in to see it.
profile.email_hint: Your email is your sign-in. To change it, contact the administrator of your organization.
security.head: Security
security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, and the devices you are signed in on.
security.password_description: Changing it signs you out on every other device, and from every connected app.
security.password_changed: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.sessions_description: Sign out of any device you don’t recognise, then change your password.
security.no_other_sessions: You’re not signed in anywhere else.

apps.scope_offline: Stay signed in when you are away
